annotations.title: Update my profile from my CV on Jobiba

description: Reads the CV file the user already uploaded to their Jobiba profile and fills the profile from it with the same rules as import_cv_text. Without apply=true it returns a preview only. If no CV file is on the profile it says so and points to the profile page.

apply.description: true only after the user approved the preview.

name: import_my_uploaded_cv
title: Update my profile from my CV on Jobiba
